name: token-watch
description: Plan usage (5-hour, weekly and any model window), the context window and the prompt cache's countdown as thin bars above the prompt. Right-click to cycle its views; click the timer to keep the cache warm; /context-bar to hide, or to read it as text where nothing draws.

snapshot.title: Usage snapshot file
snapshot.description: Write each reading to ~/.claude/token-watch/usage.json for Token Watch for VS Code. Local only; no other file is touched.
